user.title: Add Voice Normalizer
user.description: Voice Normalizer cleans up speech-to-text output and passes the result to another conversation agent, which produces the actual answer.

data_description.downstream_agent: The agent that answers the normalized request.
data_description.spelling: Decode dictated NATO letters, for example 'stav Zulu Ekko Ekko Kilo Romeo' into 'zeekr'.
data_description.spelling_mode: Strict only rewrites a spelled span when the whole span is understood.
data_description.language: Which spelling trigger words to listen for. Auto enables all of them.
data_description.alias_table: One 'spoken form: canonical form' per line, for example 'zeekr: Zeekr'.
data_description.correction_table: One 'misheard phrase: intended phrase' per line.
data_description.log_text: Include the request text in debug logs. Off by default for privacy.

error.self_reference: A normalizer cannot delegate to itself. Choose another conversation agent.
error.no_agent_selected: Select a conversation agent to delegate to.
error.agent_not_found: That conversation agent is not available.
